quotes.text: Happiness must be taken, and I will take mine.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift. That is why it is called the present.
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: You can chain my body, but you will never chain my warrior spirit!
quotes.author: Crane

quotes.text: I'm not a big fat panda. I'm THE big fat panda.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: You gotta let go of that stuff from the past because it just doesn't matter. The only thing that matters is what you choose to be now.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: He was so deadly, in fact, his enemies would go blind from over-exposure to pure awesomeness!
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: My time has come. You must now continue your journey without me. You must believe...
quotes.author: Master Oogway

quotes.text: Who are you? ... I've been asking the same question. Am I the son of a panda? The son of a goose? A student? A teacher? Turns out, I'm all of them.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: My friend, the panda will never fulfill his destiny, nor you yours, until you let go of the illusion of control.
quotes.author: Master Oogway
